firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Per rule 6b, here is the code and data behind our two Paper Track writeups.

- 68 post-cutoff tasks with snapshots, locks and wheels: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/connortynan/gemma4-fresh-tasks
- Code graphs and stand-in vectors for those tasks, in the shipped format: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/connortynan/gemma4-fresh-task-graphs
- Public submission table (151 submissions from 79 public notebooks, with verified draws): https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/connortynan/gemma4-public-submission-table
- Notebook that recomputes the table's spread: https://www.kaggle.com/code/connortynan/gemma4-submission-table-spread
- Board model, figure script and interval script for the measurement paper: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/connortynan/gemma4-garbled-edits-release

Each wheel keeps its own licence. No competition task text, gold patch or hidden-test content is included. Agent traces and prompts are withheld while the main competition is open.
